title: Wavelength song manifest (wavelength.json)
description: The manifest of a Wavelength song, format version 1.0 (docs/song-format.md, Draft 2, section 3). I-JSON: UTF-8 without a byte order mark, no key twice in an object. Readers ignore keys they do not know (section 10), so objects stay open, and value lists are open too: a reader reads a file role, author kind or requirement kind it doesn't know as the documented default. Rules a schema cannot express (NFC names, at most 255 bytes per path segment, uniqueness after case folding, files that exist and match their sha256, a files[] path that is the job) are checked by `wavelength validate` and scripts/wavelength_song.py. CC0.

formatVersion.description: The version of the spec the song follows, "major.minor", compared as two numbers (1.10 is newer than 1.9).

minReaderVersion.description: The oldest format version a reader must support to use the song correctly. Default: formatVersion's major, .0. A reader refuses a song whose minReaderVersion is newer than the newest version it supports.

generator.description: The program that last wrote the song.

id.description: Stays with the song through edits, renames and copies.

derivedFrom.description: The song this one was made from (a remix gets a new id).

slug.description: Lowercase a-z 0-9 and single hyphens between words; the folder's name and the package's name before .wavelength (so at most 244 characters).

prompt.description: The brief the song was made from.

license.description: An SPDX license expression. Missing means all rights reserved.

job.description: File name of the job, at the top of the song folder (section 4).

files.description: Every other file that belongs to the song; the job, review.json and history/ are implied.

requires.description: Written by pack: a summary of what the job needs from the computer that renders it. Never the job's source.

extensions.description: Extensions that change how a song must be read, under reverse-domain keys.

extensionsRequired.description: Extensions a reader MUST refuse the song without: a reader refuses a song that names one it doesn't know. Each should also be a key of extensions.

metadata.description: Tools' own data under reverse-domain keys, such as run.wavelength.site.

path.description: Relative to the song folder, '/' separated (section 2): not absolute (no leading '/', '~' or drive letter), no trailing '/', no empty, '.' or '..' segment. No segment has a control character or one of \ < > : " | ? *, ends with a space or '.', is a Windows device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-9, LPT1-9, any case, with or without an extension), .git (any case, ignoring trailing spaces and dots) or git~1.

hashRef.description: "sha256:" and 64 lowercase hex digits, as writers write it. A value with another algorithm's prefix is unsupported, not invalid (section 6).

kind.description: Known values: human (the default), ai. Readers read a kind they don't know as human.

path.description: Not mimetype, wavelength.json, the job or review.json, and not under history/ or out/.

role.description: Known values: source, notes, media, render, other. Readers read a role they don't know as other.

render.description: The render that goes with the song (section 8).

job.description: Hash of the job that was rendered; compare with the job's to tell whether the render is current.

requirement.description: One need of the song (section 4.3): a plugin (with an optional preset) or a library. Readers ignore an entry of a kind they don't know (neither plugin nor library, or a library kind they don't know).

track.description: The track's ID (its id, or its name when it has none).

library.description: A sample library the track plays, by name.

kind.description: Known values: multisample, kit, soundfont, sfz, files (lib: files).

fallback.description: Whether the track has a stand-in sound.
